pages.text:
Sieves loose ground for a chance at ore dusts and minerals, with FE: 20 FE/t for 5 seconds a block. Every possible find is rolled on its own; mining is still far richer.
- Gravel: flint, iron, copper, gold, silver and nickel dust.
- Sand and red sand: gold dust, Nether Quartz, fluorite and bismuth dust.
- Deepslate Gravel (cobbled deepslate in the Arc Crusher): tungsten dust, and rarer iron, gold and silver.
Arcite never turns up in a sieve.

It needs a Sifter Mesh in its mesh slot (eight rods in a ring):
- Steel Mesh: the base chances and speed, 256 blocks.
- Invar Mesh: chances x1.25, 1.5x as fast, 512 blocks.
- Tungsten Mesh: chances x1.5, twice as fast, 1,024 blocks.
Blocks and meshes go in on top (each to its own slot), finds come out underneath, FE at the back. Six output slots; a block waits until all its finds would fit. Speed and Energy upgrades.
